exponential_background — VIDEOSTREAM recursive op

• 数据种类:video → video

• 调用:import videostream; videostream.exponential_background(video, alpha: 'float' = 0.05) -> 'np.ndarray'(或 opsvideostream.get("exponential_background"))

用法

递归背景 `bg ← (1−α)·bg + α·frame 逐帧 → (T, H, W)(video`)。
